name: unbake-proto
author: ph0ryn
description: Decompile baked protobuf descriptors into human-readable working .proto

scripts.format: bun run lint --fix . ; bunx oxfmt . ; bunx eslint --fix .
scripts.precommit: bun run check && bun run format
scripts.prepack: bun run precommit && clean-pkg-json -r dependencies -r peerDependencies && bun run build
scripts.test:proto2: protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/descriptor.pb --include_imports descriptor.proto && bun run unbake test/descriptor.pb
scripts.test:proto3: protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/comprehensive.pb --include_imports test/comprehensive.proto && bun run unbake test/comprehensive.pb
